hints.title: Prefix Sum Differences
hints.text: If the first element is a0, every subsequent element is determined by a0 plus the prefix sum of differences.

hints.title: Determine the Value Range
hints.text: Track the minimum and maximum values reached by the cumulative prefix sums.

hints.title: Bound by Limits
hints.text: The valid range of a0 is bounded such that a0 + min_prefix >= lower and a0 + max_prefix <= upper.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every possible candidate for the starting element takes O(range * N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Single pass prefix tracking takes O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Express relative sequence offsets using minimum and maximum prefix deviations.
